data.title: 山田杏奈 · 篮球场边拧开的水瓶
data.description: 篮球练习结束，杏奈穿蓝色运动套装坐在场边长椅上，脖子搭着白毛巾。她用双手拧开水瓶，把瓶盖握在掌心，抬眼看见篮球慢慢滚过脚边，轻轻伸鞋尖把它停住。
data.action: 拧开水瓶握住瓶盖，用鞋尖轻停滚来的篮球。
data.promptProse: Anna Yamada rests after basketball practice on the court bench in a cobalt track jacket and matching long trousers, a white towel around her neck. She unscrews her water bottle, holding the cap in one palm, then stops a rolling basketball gently with her shoe. The medium portrait includes the court boundary and bench legs. Clear afternoon open shade evenly lights her ponytail and bottle, with firm contact shadows beneath ball and shoes.
